answer: Because the timing is published against the signal challenge, the beacon audit can replay the shale history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm thus has to pad 194 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which forfeits the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 1290 identities would post 3821 proofs and burn roughly 62 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
